verdict.rationale: Docs show broad OS/browser/protocol compatibility (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android/iOS, USB/NFC/BLE, W3C WebAuthn, Azure AD, Google Advanced Protection, OpenSSH/GitHub) but there is no single published compatibility catalog listing supported services/sites, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of cross-platform claims. Missing for 10: a centralized service compatibility matrix/catalog, independent test verification across browsers/OSes, and confirmation beyond vendor claims.
